$comment: unified-access-control-r2 task 180 (owner round 89 item 2). Every ribbon JavaScript function that creates a record or opens a create wizard, and the table it creates. A command whose action calls one of these functions must carry the display rule sprk.CreatePrivilege.<table>.DisplayRule (EntityPrivilegeRule Create, depth Basic, on that table), so a user without the Create privilege does not see it. Merge-CreatePrivilegeRule.ps1 adds the rule; Set-CreatePrivilegeRibbon.ps1 deploys and verifies it. A NEW create launcher is added here, or the command will not be ruled and -Verify will not see it.

notCreate.Spaarke.Commands.Wizards.openSummarizeFi: Summarizes uploaded files; creates nothing itself. Its follow-on cards (create project, work on analysis) are separate creates, checked server-side.
notCreate.XrmCore.Commands.Open.addNewFromSubGridS: The platform's own subgrid New; the platform rules it (Mscrm.CreateSelectedEntityPermission).

hideAppActions.decision: Owner, 2026-10-09 (task 180 fix round): hide this modern "New Document" (Matter Management, sprk_document main grid). The classic "+New Document" (sprk.Document.NewUpload.Grid.Command, same launcher, same grid) stays and carries the Create privilege rule.
